result.title: Untrained CNN and coefficient-space regularization for joint reconstruction in photoacoustic tomography
result.summary: The joint reconstruction of the initial pressure and spatially varying sound speed in photoacoustic tomography from boundary measurements is considered. A regularized data-driven framework is proposed in which the unknown fields are represented in finite-dimensional wavelet spaces and fixed nonlinear features generated by an untrained convolutional neural network (CNN) are used to reconstruct the initial-pressure coefficients through Tikhonov-regularized least squares. A learned coefficient-space prior is subsequently used to infer the squared sound-speed coefficients. Numerical experiments demonstrate accurate reconstruction on held-out data and strong generalization to previously unseen phantom geometries. The frozen reconstruction map also remains stable under measurement noise not represented during training, with only minor changes in reconstruction accuracy for noise levels up to $10\%$. In comparison with the supervised trained-CNN approach considered in this work, the untrained representation yields substantially smaller reconstruction errors while requiring approximately one-sixth of the computational time. These results demonstrate that fixed random convolutional features combined with regularized coefficient-space learning provide an efficient and robust approach to joint reconstruction in photoacoustic tomography.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究光声断层成像中初始压力与声速的联合重建，用未训练 CNN 生成的固定非线性特征表示波let系数空间中的未知场，并施加 Tikhonov 正则与学习到的系数先验，在未见几何与噪声下检验重建稳定性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「未训练冻结特征 + 系数空间正则」可作为固定表示能否替代可学习推理状态的对照线索，可能启发 LVR 中 latent 表示需否训练、冻结特征的泛化与噪声鲁棒性这一待核查问题。
